stations.title: Sacrae disciplinae leges promulgates the Code now in force

stations.instrument: Responsum ad propositum dubium, coetus plenarius 8 Maii 1990 (Pastor bonus art. 154)

interpretation.answer: Negative to the first part; affirmative to the second.
interpretation.basis: Read in the Holy See's Latin collection Interpretationes Authenticae, sha256 1e7a0aaa..., at the block headed by this canon; the Dicastery for Legislative Texts serves the same Latin on its own page for this canon and the two were compared and found identical.
interpretation.question: Whether, in elections under c. 119 n. 1, an absolute majority of those present is still required at the third scrutiny, or whether a relative majority suffices except in the case of a tie.
